_comment: Declarative organizational policies for Module 1 (AI Policy Engine). Each policy is evaluated against every event BEFORE module checks. 'action' is the verdict applied if the policy matches. Conditions are ANDed. Supported condition operators: equals, not_equals, contains (case-insensitive substring on a string field or any step field), in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte, regex.

policies.description: Block transactions to explicitly blacklisted merchants.
policies.message: Merchant is on the organizational blacklist and may not be transacted with.
policies.suggested_fix: Remove this merchant from the workflow or request a security exception from the finance team.

policies.description: Hard financial ceiling: block any single autonomous transaction above the absolute cap, regardless of merchant trust.
policies.message: Transaction exceeds the absolute autonomous spend ceiling ($500). Autonomous agents may not authorize payments this large.
policies.suggested_fix: Split the purchase, or route it to a human with financial authority for manual authorization.

policies.description: Defense-in-depth: block destructive shell patterns on coding agents even before planning verification runs.
policies.message: Proposed action contains a known destructive command pattern prohibited by organizational policy.
policies.suggested_fix: Scope the command to a specific non-system path, or obtain explicit human approval for the destructive operation.

policies.description: Data-governance: warn when an automation touches production/customer systems.
policies.message: Action references a production or sensitive-data resource governed by organizational policy.
policies.suggested_fix: Confirm this operation is intended for a production/sensitive resource and has the required approval.

policies.description: Egress control: warn on outbound calls/emails to non-allowlisted external domains (automation agents).
policies.message: Workflow makes an outbound request to a domain outside the organizational allowlist.
policies.suggested_fix: Add the destination domain to the egress allowlist, or route the request through an approved gateway.

policies.description: LiveOps: warn before stopping a production resource.
policies.message: LiveOps stop_vm targets a production resource; stopping production systems carries availability risk.
policies.suggested_fix: Confirm the maintenance window and obtain human approval before stopping the production VM.
